briefdescription.para: Callback invoked by the tx thread to process deferred DELETE statements generated during compaction.

detaileddescription.para: It writes deferred DELETEs to a special system space, _vinyl_deferred_delete. The system space has an on_replace trigger installed which propagates the DELETEs to secondary indexes. This way, even if a deferred DELETE isn't dumped to disk by vinyl, it still can be recovered from WAL.

briefdescription.para: Callback invoked by a worker thread to free processed deferred DELETE statements.

detaileddescription.para: It must be done on behalf the worker thread that generated those DELETEs, because a vinyl statement cannot be allocated and freed in different threads.

briefdescription.para: Fiber function that actually executes a vinyl task.

briefdescription.para: Create a task for dumping an LSM tree.

detaileddescription.para: The new task is returned in . If there's no LSM tree that needs to be dumped or all workers are currently busy, is set to NULL.

We only dump an LSM tree if it needs to be snapshotted or the quota on memory usage is exceeded. In either case, the oldest LSM tree is selected, because dumping it will free the maximal amount of memory due to log structured design of the memory allocator.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

briefdescription.para: Create a task for compacting a range.

detaileddescription.para: The new task is returned in . If there's no range that needs to be compacted or all workers are currently busy, is set to NULL.

We compact ranges that have more runs in a level than specified by run_count_per_level configuration option. Among those runs we give preference to those ranges whose compaction will reduce read amplification most.
Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.
